verdict.rationale: React docs confirm server-side streaming of HTML while data loads, progressively filling content before JS loads, but React itself delegates actual SSR implementation to frameworks like Next.js rather than shipping this natively as a standalone feature. missing for 10: first-party benchmarks/hands-on evidence of time-to-interactive gains, independent corroboration of streaming SSR performance, and details on how React alone (without a framework) achieves this.
